name: Narrator (Ryan, high quality)
notes: Free, offline, clear male US English voice. Used for the 'System Design: Six Problems' short. Needs the Piper package (pip install piper-tts) and, in the cloud sandbox, huggingface.co plus its download hosts (*.hf.co) allowed on the network. Set HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 if a download fails.
